items.title: 3 Ways to Play Unusual Options Activity in Kraft Heinz (KHC) Stock
items.summary: Kraft Heinz options volume surged after peer earnings spooked packaged-food stocks. Trades included a large put buy, a 5,040-contract bull call spread, and a 1,000-contract opening LEAPS call — institutions hedging near-term risk while positioning for a multi-year recovery.

items.title: Is Tyson Foods (TSN) Undervalued After Cutting Outlook And Closing Beef Plants?
items.summary: Tyson Foods (TSN) is back in focus after cutting its fiscal 2026 outlook again and moving to close or sell several beef plants, as cattle shortages and higher livestock costs squeeze margins. Tyson Foods' share price has dropped sharply in recent sessions, with a 1-day share price return of down 7.26% and a 30-day share price return of down 11.88% as investors react to the weaker outlook and plant closures.
